identity_requirements: strict canonical regular object/source files, no symlinks
objects and native source before/read/after exact file identity and SHA256
kernel16 linked outputs, protected/source maps and package78 unchanged before/after
same actual boot/release/Build ID/taint and idle before/after
one fresh isolated output leaf; stop with retained receipts on missing object, capacity/deadline or tool error; no fallback/rebuild/retry
interpretation: record actual absence of .debug_frame explicitly; do not infer a pass from empty output
frame-pointer CFA alone cannot bound local RSP allocation; retain instructions including pushes/subtractions/alignment and call sites
resolve named static callbacks from source and reject unresolved dynamic allocation/recursion for the admitted chain
wrapper fixed frame is 6 pushes plus80 private bytes plus8 return word=136 bytes
sequential cohort service with proxy_limit2 and first-missing-MM-helper handback remove source-driven nested operation recursion
sourcehost sums only the admitted nonrecursive KD chain plus separately justified ordinary Linux helper footprint; no AUX=true claim is made by capture
scope: Read-only existing-object stack/CFA and native callback source capture. No build, test, module load, syscall workload, boot, input edits or architecture changes.
